# GB rules that win over the brief (GB_WORKER_PROMPT.md, bd-rj6w0n.5.9.4.6)

- The school is in Gilgit-Baltistan (GB), grades 1-5. The period is 40 minutes; set `header.minutes` 40.
- Pupil names are ordinary Pakistani first names (Fatima, Zainab, Ayesha / Ahmed, Bilal, Ali), a girl and a boy;
  textbook characters stay characters.
- Home links come from GB life (home, bazaar, village, mountains, school), not Islamabad.
- Children use their book and notebook, never slates. No neighbour/peer talk in the opening.
- Science: write it as an English-medium subject (shape of the English example), `header.subject` "Science", and give
  an Urdu gloss for each new term.
- Islamic or religious content: no pictures of people or holy figures.
- Work every Maths answer out and check it twice.
